segments.ja517:2.1: Mātaraṃ paṭhamaṃ dajjaṃ, bhariyaṃ datvāna bhātaraṃ;
segments.ja517:2.3: Tato sahāyaṃ datvāna, pañcamaṃ dajjaṃ [dajja (syā.)] brāhmaṇaṃ;
segments.ja517:3.3: Chabbhī tayi padussati [paduṭṭhasmiṃ (sī. syā.)], paṇḍitā atthadassinī;
segments.ja517:3.5: Aññaṃ upanisaṃ katvā, vadhā taṃ parimocayi.
segments.ja517:4.1: Taṃ tādisiṃ [tādisaṃ (ka.)] pāṇadadiṃ, orasaṃ gabbhadhāriniṃ [gabbhadhāriṇiṃ (sī. syā.)];
segments.ja517:9.3: Sā maṃ sakāna puttānaṃ, ayācaṃ yācate dhanaṃ.
segments.ja517:10.1: Sohaṃ dadāmi sāratto [sārato (syā.)], bahuṃ uccāvacaṃ dhanaṃ;
segments.ja517:11.1: Yenocitā janapadā [jānapadā (sī. syā. pī.)], ānītā ca paṭiggahaṃ;
segments.ja517:13.1: Yenocitā [mayocitā (sī.), mayācitā (pī.)] janapadā, ānītā ca paṭiggahaṃ;
segments.ja517:14.3: Mayāyaṃ [mayā so (sī. pī.)] sukhito rājā, atimaññati dārako.
segments.ja517:15.1: Upaṭṭhānampi me ayye, na so eti yathā pure;
segments.ja517:16.1: Ekarattena ubhayo, tvañceva dhanusekha ca [dhanusekhavā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja517:18.1: Cariyā maṃ ayaṃ [cariyāya ayaṃ (sī. pī.)] ayye, pajagghittho [sañjagghittho (syā.)] mayā saha;
segments.ja517:21.1: Kusalo sabbanimittānaṃ, rutaññū [rudaññū (sī. syā. pī.)] āgatāgamo;
segments.ja517:21.3: Uppāte supine yutto, niyyāne ca pavesane.
segments.ja517:25.3: Pathabyā ekarājāsi, yaso te vipulaṃ gato.
segments.ja517:27.3: Sukhitānaṃ piyaṃ dīghaṃ, jīvitaṃ āhu khattiya.
segments.ja517:28.1: Atha tvaṃ kena vaṇṇena, kena vā pana hetunā;
segments.ja517:29.1: Yatopi āgato ayye, mama hatthaṃ mahosadho;
segments.ja517:30.1: Sace ca kismici kāle, maraṇaṃ me pure siyā;
segments.ja517:30.3: So me putte [putte ca me (sī. syā. pī.] paputte ca, sukhāpeyya mahosadho.
segments.ja517:31.1: Anāgataṃ paccuppannaṃ, sabbamatthampi passati [sabbamatthaṃ vipassati (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja517:33.1: Mātu bhariyāya bhātucca, sakhino brāhmaṇassa ca;
segments.ja517:33.3: Attano cāpi pañcālo, channaṃ cajati jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja517:34.1: Evaṃ mahatthikā [khahiddhiyā (syā.), mahiddhikā (ka.)] paññā, nipuṇā sādhucintinī;
